title: Docs-Blocks: Fix broken tooltip in ArgValue details
body:
Closes #33248

## What I did

* Fixed a bug in PopoverProvider's built-in close button, that didn't work with controlled-state PopoverProviders
* Fixed the HTML markup for the "show more" button in long type enums, to use HTML `details` for better keyboard and AT support
* Replaced the type `detail` tooltip with a popover
  * Fixed up the width calculation logic which was outdated and caused unnecessary horizontal scrollbars
  * Fixed the transparency bug
  * Switched to a popover, because this tooltip sometimes requires scrolling, hinting we need to be able to navigate inside it including with a keyboard (hence it needs to grab keyboard focus)
  * Added a close button, so KB users can easily close the popover

This is a pretty opinionated change. The alternative would be to use `aria-describedby` (which is the default behaviour of RAC tooltips) but I'm worried the content can be a bit long for ARIA descriptions.

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_

**Potential state desync between React and native `<details>` element.**

The `<details>` element manages its own open/closed state natively, but the button text relies on React's `isExpanded` state. If the native state changes (e.g., via assistive technology or browser behavior) without triggering `onClick`, the button text may become out of sync with the actual visibility.

Consider using the `onToggle` event to keep states synchronized:



```diff
-      <Summary isExpanded={isExpanded}>
-        {renderSummaryItems(summaryItems)}
-        <DetailsContainer>
+      <Summary isExpanded={isExpanded}>
+        {renderSummaryItems(summaryItems)}
+        <DetailsContainer
+          open={isExpanded}
+          onToggle={(e) => setIsExpanded(e.currentTarget.open)}
+        >
           <AlignedDetails>{renderExpandedItems(summaryItems)}</AlignedDetails>
-          <ExpandButton onClick={() => setIsExpanded(!isExpanded)}>
+          <ExpandButton>
             {isExpanded ? 'Show less...' : `Show ${itemsCount - ITEMS_BEFORE_EXPANSION} more...`}
           </ExpandButton>
         </DetailsContainer>
       </Summary>
```

<!-- suggestion_start -->

<details>
<summary>📝 Committable suggestion</summary>

> ‼️ **IMPORTANT**
> Carefully review the code before committing. Ensure that it accurately replaces the highlighted code, contains no missing lines, and has no issues with indentation. Thoroughly test & benchmark the code to ensure it meets the requirements.

```suggestion
    return hasManyItems ? (
      <Summary isExpanded={isExpanded}>
        {renderSummaryItems(summaryItems)}
        <DetailsContainer
          open={isExpanded}
          onToggle={(e) => setIsExpanded(e.currentTarget.open)}
        >
          <AlignedDetails>{renderExpandedItems(summaryItems)}</AlignedDetails>
          <ExpandButton>
            {isExpanded ? 'Show less...' : `Show ${itemsCount - ITEMS_BEFORE_EXPANSION} more...`}
          </ExpandButton>
        </DetailsContainer>
      </Summary>
    ) : (
      <Summary>{renderSummaryItems(summaryItems)}</Summary>
    );
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_end -->

add synchronization by making the <details> element controlled and listening for
native changes: attach a ref to the DetailsContainer (ensure it renders a
<details>), add onToggle={(e) => setIsExpanded(e.currentTarget.open)} to update
React state when the native control toggles, and set the details element's open
attribute to {isExpanded} so the native UI follows React state; keep the button
toggling setIsExpanded(!isExpanded) as before (or toggle the details via the ref
if you prefer) so both paths remain in sync.

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_

**Remove redundant `role="button"` from native `<summary>` element.**

The `<summary>` element has an implicit ARIA role of `button`, making the explicit `role="button"` attribute redundant and potentially confusing for assistive technologies. Native semantic HTML should be preferred over explicit ARIA roles when possible.



Apply this diff:

```diff
-          <ExpandButton role="button">
+          <ExpandButton>
             {isExpanded ? 'Show less...' : `Show ${itemsCount - ITEMS_BEFORE_EXPANSION} more...`}
           </ExpandButton>
```

comments.body: It is not quite redundant because some browsers do not set summary's role to button. This is explained on MDN: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/summary
